text: Post Matric Scholarships Scheme for SC Students. The last date for submission of online applications for Academic Year 2026-27 is 31-10-2026. Institute verification must be completed by 15-11-2026. Applicable for students pursuing post-matric courses (UG and PG). Annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000 per annum from all sources. Candidate must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category. Required Documents: Caste Certificate, Income Certificate, Bonafide Student Certificate, Bank Passbook copy showing Aadhaar seeded account.

URGENT NOTICE: The last date for submission of online application has been extended up to 30-11-2026. Institute verification deadline has been revised to 15-12-2026. Applicable for post-matric courses (UG and PG). Family income limit ₹2,50,000.

Merit Cum Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses CS. Last date to apply is 31 October 2026. Annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 lakh. Minimum 50% marks in the previous final examination. Required documents: Income Certificate, Bonafide Certificate.

उत्तर प्रदेश छात्रवृत्ति योजना: ऑनलाइन आवेदन करने की अंतिम तिथि 31-10-2026 है। यह योजना अन्य पिछड़ा वर्ग (OBC) के छात्रों के लिए है। परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹2,00,000 से कम होनी चाहिए। आवश्यक दस्तावेज: आय प्रमाण पत्र (Income Certificate), जाति प्रमाण पत्र (Caste Certificate)।
General Advisory for Students: Please keep your mobile number updated with Aadhaar and bank account. Do not share your OTP or password with unauthorized personnel. Ensure accurate IFSC code.

AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree/Diploma). Online application deadline is 31/10/2026. Exclusively for female students admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma. Family income limit not more than ₹8,00,000 per annum.

Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students. The portal closes on 15-11-2026. Applicants must have secured above 80th percentile in Class 12 board examination. Income of parents should not exceed ₹4,50,000 per annum.

Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship. Last date for registration is 31-10-2026. Specifically for meritorious girl students belonging to notified minority communities studying in classes 9 to 12. Income limit ₹2,00,000.
